classification.difficultyReason: Select familiar area formulas from the diagrams, use perpendicular rather than sloping height, and identify the rotated trapezium's parallel sides. The right-angle marking makes the circular region a direct quarter-circle calculation.

content.prompt: Calculate the area of the following shapes. Give an exact answer and, where necessary, an approximation correct to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Parallelogram with both pairs of parallel-side arrows; red dashed perpendicular height. Ordinary source blue outlines become black.
spec.mathematics: Base 14 cm, perpendicular height 7 cm, sloping side 8 cm.

spec.description: Triangle with horizontal base and red dashed vertical altitude from the upper vertex.
Trapezium with vertical parallel sides, matching parallel arrows and horizontal red dashed separation arrow.
spec.mathematics: Parallel sides 4 cm and 12 cm; perpendicular separation 5 cm.

spec.description: Unshaded quadrant with left vertical radius, bottom horizontal radius, right-angle marker and matching radius ticks.
